goal: Localize Orbit AI right-side result panels so user-facing text matches the active system language.

success_criteria.description: Orbit AI tool result panels use a single locale source and render Chinese user-facing copy when the active system language is Chinese, including labels, empty states, action names, confidence copy, and recovery text.
Panel tests cover follow-up context, contact recommendations, event recommendations, calendar actions, proactive messages, and general conversation results with no mixed English-Chinese UI labels.
Source identifiers, route paths, record ids, and provider names may remain English only when they are explicitly displayed as technical provenance rather than product copy.
GET /app/agent in Chinese locale shows localized right-side panels after tool calls and keeps generated answer language aligned with the user prompt.
The localization documentation lists every panel namespace and the fallback behavior when a translation key is missing.

out_of_scope: Changing generated record ids or technical provenance identifiers
